So the header parsing:
- compression at offset 36 (value 09)
- channels at offset 57 (32 bytes, offsets 57-88)
- h at offset 96 (size 512, but only 101 bytes available, offsets 96-196)

The 'h' attribute value is at offset 96, claiming 512 bytes but only 101 available (96 to 196). The header ends at offset 608 (past the file).

So the 'h' attribute value (offsets 96-196) contains the DWA compressed data. The chunk data starts at offset 96.

Wait, but earlier I thought the chunk data starts at offset 77. Let me reconsider. The 'h' attribute value starts at offset 96. So the DWA data is at offset 96.

Let me re-parse the DWA counters from offset 96.
